name: Mclust niches
author: PointillViz reference tools
description: Niches from the mix of cell types around each cell, fitted by a Gaussian mixture with mclust in R.
long_description: Describes every cell by the cell types of its nearest cells, and groups cells with similar surroundings into niches with a Gaussian mixture model (mclust). The niches are painted on the map, with a table of their sizes and main cell types. A native R tool.
citation: Scrucca L, Fop M, Murphy TB, Raftery AE. mclust 5: clustering, classification and density estimation using Gaussian finite mixture models. The R Journal 8(1), 289-317 (2016).

params.name: k
params.label: Neighbours (k)
params.help:
How many nearest cells make up the mix of cell types around each cell.
Larger values describe broader surroundings.

params.name: n_niches
params.label: Niches
params.help:
How many niches the mixture model divides the cells into.
If two niches hold the same cell types, try fewer.

params.name: seed
params.label: Random seed
params.help: Chooses the 2,000 cells the mixture is fitted to. Change it to see how stable the niches are.
